glosses: to annihilate (to reduce to nothing, to destroy, to eradicate)

examples.text: La tempête a annihilé tous leurs espoirs de voyage.
examples.translation: The storm destroyed all their hopes of traveling.
examples.english: The storm destroyed all their hopes of traveling.

examples.text: La projet a été annulé, annihilant des mois de travail et d'efforts.
examples.translation: The project was canceled, eradicating months of work and effort.
examples.english: The project was canceled, eradicating months of work and effort.

examples.text: Cette course est décisive pour sa carrière, une défaite annihilerait toute chance de se qualifier pour les championnats.
examples.translation: This race is decisive for his career; a defeat would destroy any chance of qualifying for the championships.
examples.english: This race is decisive for his career; a defeat would destroy any chance of qualifying for the championships.

examples.text: Er vernichtete alle Unterlagen, damit man ihm nichts nachweisen konnte.

glosses: To reduce to nothing, to destroy, to eradicate.

examples.text: An atom bomb can annihilate a whole city.

examples.text: of all the opinions which Antiquity hath had of men in gross, those which I most willingly embrace, and whereon I take most hold, are such as most vilifie, condemne, and annihilate us.

glosses: To render null and void; to abrogate.
